chunks: The messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: I leave behind in your midst the two weighty things, as long you hold on to them you will not go astray after me: the Book of Allah and my descendants …
ai.seo_question: What are the two weighty things the Prophet left behind to prevent his followers from going astray?
ai.summary: This pivotal hadith, recorded by al-Mufid in *Irshad*, establishes the inseparable link between the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt as the dual sources of guidance for the Shia community. It underscores the theological principle that the Prophet’s progeny serves as the living interpretation of the Divine Book, ensuring the preservation of orthodoxy after his passing. The guarantee of not going astray highlights their role as the 'Thaqalayn' (Two Weighty Things) essential for maintaining religious continuity.
